senses.gloss: क्व᳙ ind. (fr. 1. कु, Pāṇ. v, 3, 12; v, 2, 105) loc. of 2. क॑ = कस्मिन्, or कतरस्मिन्, Mn. x, 66 (क्व श्रेयस्-त्वम्, in whom is the preference?), Kathās. lxxxiii, 36
where? in what place? whither? RV. (sometimes connected with particles अ॑ह, इ॑द्, इव, स्वि॑द्) &c.
(connected with नु), Nal.; Mālav.
(with नु खलु), Śak.
(with √ भू, √ अस्) how is it with? what has become of? i.e. it is done with, RV. i, 161, 4; vii, 88, 5; AV. x, 8, 7; ŚBr.; Pāṇ. iii, 1, 12, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
(with गत) how is it with? Nal.; Daś. (क्व गतस् तव मय्य् अनुरागः, what has become of your affection for me ?)
or क्व alone may have the same meaning (e. g. क्व सुखम्, where is happiness? i.e. there is no such thing as happiness, Śāntiś.), Pañcat.; Naiṣ. i, 20
(after a negative phrase) how much less? R. i, 67, 10

क्व — क्व or कुत्र-क्व (implying excessive incongruity) where is this? where is that? how distant is this from that? how little does this agree with that? (e.g. क्व सूर्य-प्रभवो वंशः क्व चाल्प-विषया मतिः, how can my limited intellect describe the solar race? Ragh. i, 2), MBh.; R. &c.
क्वापि, anywhere, somewhere, to some place, in a certain place, Nal.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
sometimes, Sāh.; Hit.
न क्व च, nowhere, never, BhP. iv, 29, 64
न क्व चन, nowhere, MBh. xiv, 560
क्व चिद् = कस्मिंश्-चिद्, Pañcat.
anywhere, somewhere, to any place, in a certain place, Mn.; R.; Śak. &c.
in a certain case, at some time, once upon a time, Nal.; Pañcat. &c.
sometimes Comm.
क्वचिद् — क्वचिद्, here — there, here and there, in various places, MBh. i
now — then, now and then, R. iii, 50, 7; Bhartṛ. i, 4
न क्वचिद्, nowhere, never, by no means, Mn.; Yājñ.; Nal. &c.
क्वचिद् अपि न id., Megh.
यत्र क्वापि, wherever, in whatsoever place, Bhartṛ. iii, 91
य॑त्र क्व᳙-च id., ŚBr.; ChUp.; Lāṭy.; BhP.
यत्र क्व-चन, in or to whatsoever place
in any case or matter whatever, Mn. ix, 233
whenever, BhP. v, 21, 9
यत्र क्व वाथ — तत्र तत्रापि, wherever — there, BhP. i, 17, 36.
क्व—जन्मन् mfn. where born? MBh. i, 7114.
क्व—निवास mfn. where dwelling? MBh. i, 190, 31.
क्व॑स्थ mfn. where being? Pat. on Śivas. 2, Vārtt. 3.
क्वत्य mfn. being where? Pāṇ. iv, 2, 104; Pat.
क्वत्यक mf(इका)n. id., Vop. iv, 7.
क्वाचित्क mf(ई)n. (fr. क्व-चिद्), met with occasionally or somewhere (as a reading), Nyāyam. Comm. on TS. & ĀpŚr.
क्वाचित्क See क्व॑.
क्वङ्गु m. (= कङ्गु) a variety of Panic (Panicum italicum), L.
क्वण m. the sound or tone of any musical instrument, L.
sound in general, L.

क्वाण^1 m. sounding, sound (especially of a musical instrument), Sāh. 732, Sch.; Kathās. cxx, 106.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260625. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/275.
क्वाण See √ क्वण्.
क्वणन n. sounding, sound of any musical instrument, L.
क्वणन m. a small earthen pot, L.
क्वणित mfn. sounded, twanged (as a stringed instrument), W.
humming (as a bee), Vikr.
क्वणित n. sound, twang, Ragh. & Gīt. (ifc.), Bhaṭṭ.
क्वणित—वेणु mfn. one who has breathed the flute, BhP. x, 21, 12.
क्वणितेक्षण m. a vulture, Npr.
क्वथ m. (g. ज्वलादि) a decoction, extract.
क्वाथ m. (g. ज्वलादि) boiling, Yājñ. iii, 253, Sch.
a decoction, any solution or infusion prepared with a continued or gentle heat, VarBṛS. vli, 49; Suśr.; ŚārṅgS.
the mixture of the materials for a decoction, W.
pain, sorrow, distress, L.
क्वाथ &c. See √ क्वथ्.
क्वथन n. boiling by (in comp., अग्नि-), Suśr. i, 45, 4.
क्वथिका f. a decoction made with milk, Npr.
क्वथित mfn. boiled, decocted, stewed, Mn. vi, 20; Suśr.; BhP. &c.
being hot, Kathās. xc, 61
digested, W.
क्वथित n. a spirituous liquor, (prepared with honey), Npr.
क्वथिता f. a decoction prepared with Curcuma, Asa foetida, and milk, Bhpr.
क्वथित—द्रव m. spirituous liquor, Npr.
क्वाथोद्भव mfn. produced by boiling, L.
क्वाथोद्भव n. blue vitriol used as a collyrium, W.
क्वाथयितव्य mfn. to be boiled, VarBṛS. lvii, 2.
क्वाथि m. (fr. क्वथ, ‘boiling pot’, cf. कुम्भ-जन्मन्), N. of Agastya, L.
क्व्-अधः-स्थ mfn. (fr. 2. कु), ‘standing below on the earth’, KaṭhUp. i, 28 (a wrong reading).
क्वधस्थ accord. to some read सधस्थम्.
क्व॑यि m. a kind of bird, VS. xxiv, 29; TS. v, 5, 17, 1 (= मृग-विशेष, Sch.)
क्व᳙ल m. pl. (= कु॑वल) jujube fruit (used for coagulating substances), TS. ii, 5, 3, 5.
क्व्-अह See 2. कु at end.
क्वापि See क्व॑.
